questions.question_english: What is the primary characteristic of an adaptive assessment in digital education platforms?
options_english: The software alters question difficulty dynamically based on previous user responses
Every candidate receives the exact same fixed set of questions regardless of performance
Questions are displayed in reverse alphabetical order relative to the candidate’s name
Candidate assessment scores are published publicly only after a multi-year processing delay
questions.explanation_english: The primary characteristic of adaptive assessment in digital educational platforms is the dynamic adjustment of question difficulty based on real-time test-taker performance. As a student answers questions, testing algorithms evaluate accuracy to select subsequent items tailored to the user’s demonstrated proficiency level. This adaptive testing methodology provides precise measurements of student knowledge while avoiding the inefficiencies of static, uniform exam papers.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। डिजिटल शिक्षा प्लेटफार्मों में अनुकूलन मूल्यांकन की प्राथमिक विशेषता वास्तविक समय में परीक्षा लेने वाले के प्रदर्शन के आधार पर प्रश्नों की कठिनाई का गतिशील समायोजन है। जब एक छात्र प्रश्नों का उत्तर देता है, तो परीक्षण एल्गोरिदम सटीकता का मूल्यांकन करते हैं ताकि उपयोगकर्ता की प्रदर्शित दक्षता स्तर के अनुसार अगले प्रश्नों का चयन किया जा सके। यह अनुकूलन परीक्षण पद्धति छात्र ज्ञान के सटीक माप प्रदान करती है जबकि स्थिर, समान परीक्षा पत्रों की अक्षमताओं से बचती है।
key_facts: Adaptive assessments adjust question difficulty based on user performance.
They provide tailored testing experiences for each student.
Printed answer key: (A) The software alters question difficulty
This methodology enhances the accuracy of knowledge measurement.

questions.explanation_english: The gender dimension of the digital divide manifests as reduced technology adoption rates among women due to intersecting socio-cultural and economic factors.
